source.title: Peptide-Based Scaffolds Support Human Cortical Progenitor Graft Integration to Reduce Atrophy and Promote Functional Repair in a Model of Stroke

material: Fmoc-DDIKVAV self-assembling peptide hydrogel (IKVAV SAP) with hESC-derived cortical progenitors

formulation.evidence: On day of use, Fmoc-SAP powder was dissolved to 20 mg/mL in deionized water and pH corrected to 7.4.
Final concentration of implanted SAP gels was 10 mg/mL and total number of cells 100,000/rat.
At the time of implantation, cells were diluted 1:1 in the hydrogel or HBSS media to a final density of 50,000 cells/mL.

processing.evidence: On day of use, Fmoc-SAP powder was dissolved to 20 mg/mL in deionized water and pH corrected to 7.4.
At time of implantation, the gel underwent mechanical sheering and was mixed 1:1 with Hank’s balanced salt solution (HBSS) or cells.
animals received two intra­cortical injections (1 mL each) of hESC-derived cortical progenitor and/or SAP gels into the lesion site

description.value: SAP scaffold gel integrity maintained (fibers visible in slices)
description.evidence: SAP fibers were visible within the slices, indicating maintained integrity of the SAP scaffold gel at 9 months

duration_days.evidence: SAP fibers were visible within the slices, indicating maintained integrity of the SAP scaffold gel at 9 months

biology.species: human cells in athymic nude rat

other_outcomes.evidence: grafts in the presence of SAP scaffolds were notably larger (cells: 3.5 ± 1.8 mm3 and cells+SAP: 10.7 ± 3.8 mm3
other_outcomes.name: graft volume (cells+SAP)

other_outcomes.evidence: cell + SAP grafts were more differentiated and homogeneous with 69.6% ± 2.9% NEUN+ /GFP+ DAPI+
other_outcomes.name: NEUN+/GFP+ DAPI+ neuronal proportion in graft

other_outcomes.evidence: cells+SAP grafts contained a significant increase in the proportion of both BRN2 (65.8 ± 4.4%) and TBR1 (20.0 ± 2.7%) neurons
other_outcomes.name: BRN2+ proportion of neurons

other_outcomes.evidence: cells+SAP grafts contained a significant increase in the proportion of both BRN2 (65.8 ± 4.4%) and TBR1 (20.0 ± 2.7%) neurons
other_outcomes.name: TBR1+ proportion of neurons

other_outcomes.evidence: an effect that was greatest in cells+SAP-grafted ani­mals (11.4 ± 1.3% cortical atrophy; Figures 7A and 7I)
other_outcomes.name: cortical atrophy (implant at 3 weeks)

other_outcomes.evidence: early implants of cells+SAP significantly reduced atrophy (4.9 ± 0.8%) compared to intervention at 3 weeks
other_outcomes.name: cortical atrophy (implant at 6 days)

other_outcomes.evidence: By 36 weeks cells+SAP implants continued to provide a significant benefit (41.3 ± 1.3%)
other_outcomes.name: staircase impaired paw pellet retrieval

other_outcomes.evidence: Only ischemic animals receiving cells+SAP grafts showed a sig­nificant improvement in left paw use compared to ET1-lesioned rats (52.1 ± 5.5% and 26.5 ± 4.7% wall touches using left paw, respectively)
other_outcomes.name: cylinder test left paw wall touches

other_outcomes.evidence: cell graft: 14.5 ± 1.5% and cells+SAP graft: 13.9 ± 0.7%; Figure 5C
other_outcomes.name: RECA1+ vessel area in graft
resting membrane potential of grafted neurons

notes: Implanted into ET1-induced ischemic sensorimotor cortex lesion at 3 weeks (or 6 days) post-lesion; assessed at 36 weeks. Modulus reported only in figure as similar to rat brain (shear rheology).
